geometry.frame: Crop in oriented-source coordinates before rotation, then output at renderScale; preserve full frame including margins. Source mapping follows Task5 crop/rotation, no viewport dependency.
geometry.cellPitch: At scale s: cw=3*fontSize*s/5, ch=fontSize*s; retain rational boundaries, never round pitch before grid generation.
geometry.grid: ceil(width/cw) columns and ceil(height/ch) rows; last partial rectangles intersect frame. Pixel/Mosaic fill full frame at gap0. Braille includes partial cells (different from bounded reference floor).
geometry.coverageRaster: For every destination pixel center (x+0.5,y+0.5), evaluate its owning half-open rectangle; left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive. No antialiasing for Pixel/Mosaic straight rectangles.
geometry.rounding: All channel bytes clamp(round_half_up(value),0,255); round_half_up(v)=floor(v+0.5) for nonnegative v. Coordinates and accumulators f64; loops row-major.

sampling.origin: independent alpha-safe area contract, not reference center/sparse sampling
equations: Sample exact rectangle overlap areas w_i with oriented source pixel squares after crop/rotation mapping; clip to valid source rectangle. A=sum(w_i*a_i)/sum(w_i), where a_i=alphaByte_i/255. RGB=sum(w_i*a_i*RGB_i)/sum(w_i*a_i), or RGB=(0,0,0) when numerator alpha denominator is zero. Preserve A separately.

Apply per-channel K=259*(contrast+255)/(255*(259-contrast)); T(c)=clamp(K*(c-128)+128+255*brightness/100,0,255). For Pixel/Mosaic if invert=1 replace T with255-T. No range normalization, edges, threshold suppression, hidden blur or color grading.

Pixel/Mosaic use cell-wide sample; Mosaic wide/tall use entire merged rectangle. Braille uses each spatial dot rectangle separately for bit activation; full cell sample supplies glyph color and alpha.
sampling.outOfBounds: Exclude area outside source; zero-area sample yields transparent black. No clamping into neighboring edge pixels.
sampling.alpha: Hidden RGB at alpha0 contributes nothing; reject premultiplied input unless converted at browser boundary; output is straight-alpha sRGB.

order: prepare fixed blur backdrop from original source
multiply source A by charOpacity/100 and mask
source-over family layer over fixed backdrop
equations: For atlas coverage m in[0,1], layer alpha=round_half_up(255*A*charOpacity/100*m); RGB family color rounded once after family operation; when layer alpha=0 force RGB=0. Pixel/Mosaic m=1 inside tile,0 outside.
No overlapping tile interiors. Compose completed family layer over the fixed baseline backdrop using sharedBackdrop below; do not emit the uncomposited layer as final output.
composition.scale: All source geometry including cells scales by s before rasterization. Scale changes density only through raster resolution, never through source-cell count; atlas is calibrated for requested effective size.

sharedBackdrop.origin: existing independently specified Characters complete-context-v1 approximation; reuse/extract pure primitives in Task5 without altering Characters ABI or behavior
sharedBackdrop.resize: Map output pixel centers into cropped/rotated source extent: x=(outX+0.5)/scale-0.5,y likewise. Bilinear four taps with edge-clamped integer coordinates; interpolate premultiplied RGB in byte units and alpha0..1. Store each result in f32. Source pixels for backdrop are original, not family tone-adjusted.
sharedBackdrop.blur: Three separable box filters with radius[8s-1,8s-1,8s], each horizontal then vertical (6passes), edge-clamped samples. Accumulate moving sums f64, store each pass f32. Width2r+1. This approximates sigma8*s; not browser blur parity.
sharedBackdrop.over: Let layer byte alpha aL=Lalpha/255; premultiplied backdrop RGB B and alpha aB. a=aL+aB*(1-aL). Rounded alpha=floor(255*a+0.5). If rounded alpha0 output[0,0,0,0]; else RGB=round_half_up(clamp((Lrgb*aL+B*(1-aL))/a,0,255)). Never flatten to opaque black.
sharedBackdrop.memory: Two full-frame f32 RGBA scratch planes (32bytes/output pixel), layer/output plus wire/encoder and active ownership counted under unchanged budgets; reject before allocation, report actual capacities. Existing Characters estimator cannot be assumed valid for larger ceil-grid/256atlas; Task3/5 must recompute.

resourceContract.dictionary: exactly256 ordered glyph entries U+2800+i for i0..255; packet atlasCount256; literalSpaceIndex65535 (Braille blank is not literal space). U+2800 must have zero mask; U+28FF must not have zero mask. Existing atlas capacity/backing/coverage/metadata validation remains mandatory. Font fallback missing dictionary/calibration is explicit failure.
resourceContract.placement: Top-left cell origin; atlas origin offset normalized as existing atlas contract; mask values coverage/255; clipped full-frame bounds. No coverage sorting or ramp matching. Glyph identity selected by bit index.
resourceContract.limits: A dictionary of256 may exceed present atlas/cell/memory capacity on a particular size; reject before allocating, never silently replace by a reduced atlas.

familyRule.dotSubdivision: Each cell divides into2columns,4rows. Row-major spatial bit table[[0,3],[1,4],[2,5],[6,7]]. Each dot rectangle alpha-safe area sample; L=(.299T(R)+.587T(G)+.114T(B))/255. Bit set iff A>0 and L>=brailleThreshold/100; invert1 negates luminance before comparison (not finished glyph RGB). Glyph color comes from full-cell tone RGB without inversion.
familyRule.blank: mask0 selects U+2800, paints no glyph; no rectangle/dots substitute.
familyRule.difference: Reference samples four points per dot with normalized luminance and ordered thresholds; this independent absolute threshold preserves bit layout but does not reproduce that renderer.

geometry.frame: Crop in oriented-source coordinates before rotation, then output at renderScale; preserve full frame including margins. Source mapping follows Task5 crop/rotation, no viewport dependency.
geometry.cellPitch: At scale s: cw=3*fontSize*s/5, ch=fontSize*s; retain rational boundaries, never round pitch before grid generation.
geometry.grid: ceil(width/cw) columns and ceil(height/ch) rows; last partial rectangles intersect frame. Pixel/Mosaic fill full frame at gap0. Braille includes partial cells (different from bounded reference floor).
geometry.coverageRaster: For every destination pixel center (x+0.5,y+0.5), evaluate its owning half-open rectangle; left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive. No antialiasing for Pixel/Mosaic straight rectangles.
geometry.rounding: All channel bytes clamp(round_half_up(value),0,255); round_half_up(v)=floor(v+0.5) for nonnegative v. Coordinates and accumulators f64; loops row-major.

sampling.origin: independent alpha-safe area contract, not reference center/sparse sampling
equations: Sample exact rectangle overlap areas w_i with oriented source pixel squares after crop/rotation mapping; clip to valid source rectangle. A=sum(w_i*a_i)/sum(w_i), where a_i=alphaByte_i/255. RGB=sum(w_i*a_i*RGB_i)/sum(w_i*a_i), or RGB=(0,0,0) when numerator alpha denominator is zero. Preserve A separately.

Apply per-channel K=259*(contrast+255)/(255*(259-contrast)); T(c)=clamp(K*(c-128)+128+255*brightness/100,0,255). For Pixel/Mosaic if invert=1 replace T with255-T. No range normalization, edges, threshold suppression, hidden blur or color grading.

Pixel/Mosaic use cell-wide sample; Mosaic wide/tall use entire merged rectangle. Braille uses each spatial dot rectangle separately for bit activation; full cell sample supplies glyph color and alpha.
sampling.outOfBounds: Exclude area outside source; zero-area sample yields transparent black. No clamping into neighboring edge pixels.
sampling.alpha: Hidden RGB at alpha0 contributes nothing; reject premultiplied input unless converted at browser boundary; output is straight-alpha sRGB.

order: prepare fixed blur backdrop from original source
multiply source A by charOpacity/100 and mask
source-over family layer over fixed backdrop
equations: For atlas coverage m in[0,1], layer alpha=round_half_up(255*A*charOpacity/100*m); RGB family color rounded once after family operation; when layer alpha=0 force RGB=0. Pixel/Mosaic m=1 inside tile,0 outside.
No overlapping tile interiors. Compose completed family layer over the fixed baseline backdrop using sharedBackdrop below; do not emit the uncomposited layer as final output.
composition.scale: All source geometry including cells scales by s before rasterization. Scale changes density only through raster resolution, never through source-cell count; atlas is calibrated for requested effective size.

sharedBackdrop.origin: existing independently specified Characters complete-context-v1 approximation; reuse/extract pure primitives in Task5 without altering Characters ABI or behavior
sharedBackdrop.resize: Map output pixel centers into cropped/rotated source extent: x=(outX+0.5)/scale-0.5,y likewise. Bilinear four taps with edge-clamped integer coordinates; interpolate premultiplied RGB in byte units and alpha0..1. Store each result in f32. Source pixels for backdrop are original, not family tone-adjusted.
sharedBackdrop.blur: Three separable box filters with radius[8s-1,8s-1,8s], each horizontal then vertical (6passes), edge-clamped samples. Accumulate moving sums f64, store each pass f32. Width2r+1. This approximates sigma8*s; not browser blur parity.
sharedBackdrop.over: Let layer byte alpha aL=Lalpha/255; premultiplied backdrop RGB B and alpha aB. a=aL+aB*(1-aL). Rounded alpha=floor(255*a+0.5). If rounded alpha0 output[0,0,0,0]; else RGB=round_half_up(clamp((Lrgb*aL+B*(1-aL))/a,0,255)). Never flatten to opaque black.
sharedBackdrop.memory: Two full-frame f32 RGBA scratch planes (32bytes/output pixel), layer/output plus wire/encoder and active ownership counted under unchanged budgets; reject before allocation, report actual capacities. Existing Characters estimator cannot be assumed valid for larger ceil-grid/256atlas; Task3/5 must recompute.

geometry.frame: Crop in oriented-source coordinates before rotation, then output at renderScale; preserve full frame including margins. Source mapping follows Task5 crop/rotation, no viewport dependency.
geometry.cellPitch: At scale s: cw=3*fontSize*s/5, ch=fontSize*s; retain rational boundaries, never round pitch before grid generation.
geometry.grid: ceil(width/cw) columns and ceil(height/ch) rows; last partial rectangles intersect frame. Pixel/Mosaic fill full frame at gap0. Braille includes partial cells (different from bounded reference floor).
geometry.coverageRaster: For every destination pixel center (x+0.5,y+0.5), evaluate its owning half-open rectangle; left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive. No antialiasing for Pixel/Mosaic straight rectangles.
geometry.rounding: All channel bytes clamp(round_half_up(value),0,255); round_half_up(v)=floor(v+0.5) for nonnegative v. Coordinates and accumulators f64; loops row-major.

sampling.origin: independent alpha-safe area contract, not reference center/sparse sampling
equations: Sample exact rectangle overlap areas w_i with oriented source pixel squares after crop/rotation mapping; clip to valid source rectangle. A=sum(w_i*a_i)/sum(w_i), where a_i=alphaByte_i/255. RGB=sum(w_i*a_i*RGB_i)/sum(w_i*a_i), or RGB=(0,0,0) when numerator alpha denominator is zero. Preserve A separately.

Apply per-channel K=259*(contrast+255)/(255*(259-contrast)); T(c)=clamp(K*(c-128)+128+255*brightness/100,0,255). For Pixel/Mosaic if invert=1 replace T with255-T. No range normalization, edges, threshold suppression, hidden blur or color grading.

Pixel/Mosaic use cell-wide sample; Mosaic wide/tall use entire merged rectangle. Braille uses each spatial dot rectangle separately for bit activation; full cell sample supplies glyph color and alpha.
sampling.outOfBounds: Exclude area outside source; zero-area sample yields transparent black. No clamping into neighboring edge pixels.
sampling.alpha: Hidden RGB at alpha0 contributes nothing; reject premultiplied input unless converted at browser boundary; output is straight-alpha sRGB.

order: prepare fixed blur backdrop from original source
multiply source A by charOpacity/100 and mask
source-over family layer over fixed backdrop
equations: For atlas coverage m in[0,1], layer alpha=round_half_up(255*A*charOpacity/100*m); RGB family color rounded once after family operation; when layer alpha=0 force RGB=0. Pixel/Mosaic m=1 inside tile,0 outside.
No overlapping tile interiors. Compose completed family layer over the fixed baseline backdrop using sharedBackdrop below; do not emit the uncomposited layer as final output.
composition.scale: All source geometry including cells scales by s before rasterization. Scale changes density only through raster resolution, never through source-cell count; atlas is calibrated for requested effective size.

sharedBackdrop.origin: existing independently specified Characters complete-context-v1 approximation; reuse/extract pure primitives in Task5 without altering Characters ABI or behavior
sharedBackdrop.resize: Map output pixel centers into cropped/rotated source extent: x=(outX+0.5)/scale-0.5,y likewise. Bilinear four taps with edge-clamped integer coordinates; interpolate premultiplied RGB in byte units and alpha0..1. Store each result in f32. Source pixels for backdrop are original, not family tone-adjusted.
sharedBackdrop.blur: Three separable box filters with radius[8s-1,8s-1,8s], each horizontal then vertical (6passes), edge-clamped samples. Accumulate moving sums f64, store each pass f32. Width2r+1. This approximates sigma8*s; not browser blur parity.
sharedBackdrop.over: Let layer byte alpha aL=Lalpha/255; premultiplied backdrop RGB B and alpha aB. a=aL+aB*(1-aL). Rounded alpha=floor(255*a+0.5). If rounded alpha0 output[0,0,0,0]; else RGB=round_half_up(clamp((Lrgb*aL+B*(1-aL))/a,0,255)). Never flatten to opaque black.
sharedBackdrop.memory: Two full-frame f32 RGBA scratch planes (32bytes/output pixel), layer/output plus wire/encoder and active ownership counted under unchanged budgets; reject before allocation, report actual capacities. Existing Characters estimator cannot be assumed valid for larger ceil-grid/256atlas; Task3/5 must recompute.
